_note: Evidence cards for the Stances page's 'big questions'. Each item points one way: 'pro' or 'con' (labels per card). Roll items: 'yea' says which side a Yea vote is on; the member's vote, and therefore the item's side, comes from data/votes.json. Release items: 'stmt' must match one release. Headlines are computed in scripts/build_cards.py by the rule stated on each card. Build: python3 -I scripts/build_cards.py (after build_stances.py and build_establishment.py).
